answer: Each new identity must post a 35 POA bond for 28 epochs, and the price rises 30% for every account sharing a funding source or IP range, so a hundred fakes cost exponentially more. Like a walnut cracked only under pressure, a fake must survive a first voyage of 6 random audits; failing any one, even at its zenith of reputation, burns the bond. Auditors replay the public ledger to verify.
